svg.title: From the server room to the sensor: the same OS ideas, different priorities
svg.text: From the server room to the sensor: the same OS ideas, different priorities
less energy, less memory, more deadlines; the OS must also manage energy, heat, radios and sensors
Orders of magnitude for typical devices of 2026, not limits: each class contains much smaller and much larger devices.
